utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m ready to help with the repair drive—what’s the first thing we need to tackle?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Let’s start by listing the biggest repairs first, then we can split up the jobs and see what parts we’re missing.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That sounds sensible. I’ll jot down the biggest repairs and keep an eye on what parts we still need.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it. I’ll keep it short—what’s the headline on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: We should confirm the scope, the list of items, and who’s responsible before we call it done.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Right — scope, list, owners. I’ll get those three locked down.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll jot down the repair drive details carefully so I don’t miss anything. Tell me what still needs doing, and I’ll add it to my list.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks — I think we still need to confirm the date, what tools are needed, and who’s bringing snacks. I’m a bit scattered, so if you write it down, I’ll follow along.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Absolutely—I’ve got the date to confirm, the tools list to gather, and snacks to assign. I’ll keep it neat on my list, and you can fill in whatever you remember next.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m still figuring out the repair drive, honestly. If you’ve got a lead, I’d rather hear it one-on-one.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I do have one, but I’d like to keep it simple and scheduled. Tell me the basics first, and I’ll help you pin down the next step.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: The basics are that it’s the old drive unit by the shed, and it’s been acting up since yesterday. I can bring the parts list if you want to go over it quietly.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What exactly needs repairing, and when do you need it done?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Mostly the fence and the front gate, if folks are willing. I’d love to get it done this weekend, if that works.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Okay—how much of the fence, and is the gate just a latch issue or a full fix?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive’s getting a pretty good turnout, but I’m not sure if they’ve confirmed the final list yet. Either way, it’s nice to see everyone pitching in.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, that’s the best part—folks showing up and lending a hand. I can bring a few tools and help wherever they need me.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’d be wonderful, Gus — I’m sure they’ll be glad for the extra hands. I’ll ask around and see what else they still need.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Count me in, Opal — I’ll spread the word right away and get folks lined up for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect, Quinn — I appreciate that. I’ll pin down the exact drop-off location and timings so everyone has the same details.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great — once you’ve got the details, send them my way and I’ll blast them out to everyone I know.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I can help out with the repair drive. Just tell me what needs doing, and I’ll pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks, Sam. What exactly needs doing, and do you have a source or confirmation for the parts list?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I haven’t got the parts list in front of me yet, but I can check on it and confirm what’s needed. Once I have that, I’ll help get the pieces sorted.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Just checking we're still on for the repair drive, and if anything changes, I’ll update the group chat right away.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, still on for the repair drive. If anything changes on my end, I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, thank you — I’ll keep an eye on things and let everyone know if I hear anything. Just ping me if your timing shifts at all.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll keep the repair drive moving and repeat the plan to folks as I see them. Let’s make sure everyone hears the same next step.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’s the right idea, Vik. Let’s keep the plan steady and simple so nobody gets mixed up.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll keep it steady and simple, and I’ll keep repeating the next step to everyone I run into.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I’m happy to help with the repair drive, though I might need a reminder on the details. What was the plan again?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: We’re gathering tools and supplies for the repair drive, then sorting them by what’s needed most. I’m still checking the list, but that’s the part I’m sure of.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—tools and supplies first, then sort them by priority. I can help with that as soon as you’ve got the list together.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m in for the repair drive — happy to help however I can. If you’ve got a sign-up list or a time, send it my way.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That’s great, Jules — I’ll keep an ear out for the sign-up list and the time. If I hear anything, I’ll run it over right away.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect — thanks, Ira. I’ll keep myself open and ready to pitch in as soon as you hear back.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m spreading the word about the repair drive now—whoever’s got tools, time, or a helping hand, send them over. We’ll get a solid turnout if we keep it moving fast.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I’m a bit late, but I can swing by with tools after my shift. Just tell me what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect — your tools will be a huge help, and I’ll point you straight to what’s still open when you get here. If anyone else can spare a hand, tell them to come on by too.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m still gathering my thoughts on the repair drive. If you want, I can walk you through what I’ve heard so far.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, please do—I'd like the details in order, so I can keep the plan straight.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure — first I heard the drive needs a quick parts check, then a test pass, and after that we can decide what still needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help, but I’m going to keep it tight around school pickup times. What do you need from me for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That works for me, Faye. I’ll keep your role focused around pickup hours and send you the details you need for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect — send me the pickup-hour details, and I’ll slot it into my schedule.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I think the repair drive could really bring folks together — if we keep it simple and practical, people will show up.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, that’s the right way to do it — simple and practical, that’s what gets people in the door. We keep it clear, we keep it useful, and folks will show up.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Exactly — if we make it easy to help, people from every group will pitch in. I can spread the word and keep it practical.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can lend a hand and bring a few tools. Let me know what needs fixing, and I’ll see what I can do.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That’d be helpful, Gus. If you can bring the tools, I’d like to make a simple list first so we don’t miss anything.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good — send over the list when you’ve got it, and I’ll bring what I can.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ve got the repair drive pinned down exactly — if you want, I can tell you the best route and timing for it.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes please — send me the best route and timing, and I’ll make sure everyone in the chat is on the same page.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Absolutely — take the north entrance off Maple, then follow the loop to the service lot; if you leave around 8:15, you’ll miss the morning bottleneck.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What exactly do you need from the repair drive, and by when?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I need a clear list of the items and any specs before I say yes. If it’s for this week, I’d want it confirmed as soon as possible.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Understood—send me the exact item list and specs, and I’ll confirm whether we can do it this week.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I can help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thank you, Sam. I’d like you to note down the needed supplies and wait for my list before we start.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: You got it — I’ll note down the supplies and wait for your list before we start.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve only heard bits and pieces from the neighbors, but I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Honestly, I’m a bit behind on the latest—what’s still left to do for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m still piecing it together too, but I can ask around and get you the latest. If you want, I’ll check with the neighbors and come back with what’s left.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: I’m not signing off on anything until I see the source and the confirmation in writing. What exactly is wrong with the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Fair enough — I don’t have the confirmed details yet, just that folks are saying something’s off with the repair drive. Let me check and I’ll bring you the source in writing.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: That works for me—bring me the source and the written confirmation, and then we can talk specifics.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard folks are still gathering tools and parts for the repair drive. If you want, I can run by and see what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks. If you go, ask what they still need most — I’m not sure on the rest.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure thing — I’ll ask what they need most and bring back the word.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — the repair drive. I’m afraid I’ve mixed up the details, but I’m happy to help however Leo thinks is best.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Good. Start with the busted tools list and I’ll sort the rest.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing, Leo — I’ll start with the busted tools list right away. Just point me where you want it sorted.
